freeze_rule: Freeze (status FROZEN, training and evaluation seeds allocated, commit) before any replicate training starts. Every replicate is reported; none may be dropped, retrained or selected.
classification: Independent training-seed replication of the 2v2 Ours teachers. Same recipe, new training seeds only.
question: Does complementary A/B specialisation re-emerge when the exact 2v2 dual-branch recipe is retrained from the same foundations with new seeds, or was the original pair one lucky PPO seed?

recipe_frozen.source: 2v2/run_dual_branch_2v2.py train_args (the recipe that produced the sealed 2v2 teachers); identical argv except --seed, --experiment-id and --run-label-suffix
recipe_frozen.after_training: export each ATTACK branch exactly as the 2v2 driver does (export_attack_branch), then a technical seal per replicate

replicates.compute: 6 runs of 200k steps; the original took about 50 min per run; run 3 at a time

evaluation_frozen.pairs: rep1, rep2, rep3 AND the original sealed pair (so all four pairs are read on identical seeds)
evaluation_frozen.seed_class: sealed_confirmatory, shared by all four pairs
evaluation_frozen.episode_path: experiments/eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py with the dual-branch composite flags used for the 2v2 matched-128 (--role-fixed-for-episode --role-k-defend 1 --frozen-attack-path(-b) + shas, --dual-branch-deploy-manifest per pair)

analysis_frozen.per_pair: Delta_A = V(A,A) - V(B,A), Delta_B = V(B,B) - V(A,B), win, paired bootstrap 95% (n = 20000, rng 7)
analysis_frozen.headline: per-pair mean Delta_A and Delta_B for all four pairs, plus the mean and range across the three NEW replicates
analysis_frozen.replication_count: number of new replicates (of 3) with BOTH mean Delta_A > 0 and mean Delta_B > 0, reported as k/3
analysis_frozen.no_selection: replicates are never ranked, filtered or swapped; a replicate that fails to train is reported as such

depends_on: nothing; runs after the 4v4 Stage-4 chain finishes (user ordering)
